verdict_rationale: The claim under attack asserts a founder-facing comparison table can be built ENTIRELY from receipt-backed numbers with no illustrative placeholders. 3 of 4 properties (density, Tg, refractive index) support real, receipt-backed {physics, ML, stack} triplets -- that part of the claim SURVIVES. But the claim's implicit premise -- that every property cell in such a table can be filled with a competent positive point estimate -- is REFUTED for dielectric constant: no {physics, ML, stack} arm beats a mean baseline on physically-valid data, and the number the shipped KPI would otherwise supply (R2=0.64) is an artifact of a corrupted, low-variance majority label, not real skill. A table built by (mis)citing that number to fill the dielectric cell would BE an illustrative placeholder wearing a receipt's clothing. The only receipt-backed way to fill that cell honestly is the negative result recorded here.
